10192012.note: The lidar relief shows the campground's lanes plainly under the leaves: the entrance from the road, the west loop, the turnaround by the shore and the lane east along the lake to its small loop, with the drawn roads on them and lighter pads along the shore in the intensity. OpenStreetMap's outline holds all of it and the point is inside. Nothing traced.

10192062.note: The lidar relief shows the campground loop by the lake plainly under the leaves, with short spurs off its south side toward the shore, and the drawn roads sit on it; OpenStreetMap's outline holds the loop. The point is about 10 m outside the outline's north edge, 45 m from the loop, rather than at the entrance on the west. Nothing traced.

10192097.note: The lidar relief shows the campground loop on the point plainly under the canopy, joining the road at both ends with the turnaround at its south end, and the drawn roads sit on it. OpenStreetMap's outline holds the loop and the point is inside it, by the loop's north lane. Nothing traced.

10192127.note: The lidar survey is too sparse here (0.5 ground points per m²): the relief shows only faint broken lines near the road in at the north end and none that is plainly the loop, and the intensity is mottled, so the outline on the lakeshore point and the loop in it can't be checked. Nothing traced.

10315092.note: The outline follows a strip with spur roads and pads in the trees beside the highway, and the point is inside it at the south end near the road in.

10315097.note: The outline follows a small fenced area of trees with a short drive in open grassland, and the point is inside it.

10315102.note: Moved the pin about 640 m east-southeast from an open hillside onto the campground the listing describes: the turnaround loop on Forest Road 805 beside the 15-paddock corral, with a trailer parked at it. There's no outline, so the map shows the pin there.

232062.note: The pin sits on the clearing with a small building at the end of the drawn lane west of the parking lot. The listing's own point is 1.7 km away, but the photo shows the group site here.

232359.note: The pin sits by the clearings and parked vehicles at the end of the drawn road up the gulch, which follows the visible track.

233207.note: The pin sits on the open group field, and the drawn spur reaches it from the campground road.

233212.note: The pin sits on a long grassy opening in the forest with no road or track drawn or visible to it, and the listing's own point is 4.2 km away; nothing on the photo shows it is the campsite.

233765.note: The pin sits at the edge of the open gravel clearing on the point, and the drawn lane reaches the clearing.

234235.note: The lidar relief shows unbroken forest floor at the pin, with no building-shaped gap in the ground returns, pad or lane within 50 m, so the pin isn't on the cabin; nothing that could be the cabin shows within 150 m either, and the nearest drawn road is 150 m south-east. Nothing traced.

234273.note: The pin sits by the small building in the clearing beside the drawn forest road at the junction, which follows the visible track.

234678.note: The lidar intensity shows the drawn spur from the road as a light gravel band past the pin, and a gravel clearing 45 to 95 m south of the pin beside the spur, where the photo shows a couple of small blue objects under the trees; that clearing may be the horse camp, but nothing shows it plainly, and the listing's own point is 1.7 km away. Nothing traced or moved.

234679.note: The pin sits in the open clearing inside the drawn loop, which follows the visible gravel; the clearing has fire rings and pads.

234734.note: The lidar layers don't settle it: the survey is sparse (2 ground points per m²), the relief at the pin is coarse and shows no building gap or pad, and neither layer shows the drawn track ending 40 m south-west. The photo shows only unbroken canopy by the lake. Nothing traced.

265539.note: The pin sits on a small clearing 15 m south of the drawn turnaround loop, which follows the visible gravel; no spur to the pin is drawn.

273338.note: The pin sits by the small clearing on the lakeshore where the drawn forest track ends.

273340.note: The lidar returns thin out to smooth facets along the shore, so neither layer can show a pad at the pin. The relief and the photo show an undrawn dirt track running south-east to the lakeshore 45 m north of the pin, while the drawn loop and the road in from the west follow no lane the relief shows; the listing's own point is 2.6 km away. Nothing traced.

273341.note: The pin sits by the clearing on the lakeshore just north of the drawn forest road, which reaches it.

273344.note: The pin sits on the lakeshore 25 m south of a small clearing that is likely the campsite, under the trees; no road or trail is drawn to it, so it is reached by water or on foot.

273350.note: The pin sits in the open clearing among the pads, between the drawn lanes, which follow the visible tracks.

273351.note: The lidar relief confirms the drawn track to the west, but at the pin it shows only level forest floor with a short slope edge 10 m north, no pad, clearing or lane; the intensity is washed out by sandy ground. The site can't be placed. Nothing traced.

273353.note: The lidar relief shows a creek channel and its bank beside the drawn track's west half, and the track may run along a dark line at the bank's foot, but it can't be told from a ditch; at the pin by the shore the ground returns thin to smooth facets, with no pad or clearing. Nothing traced.

273356.note: The pin sits in the forest 15 m east of the clearing where the drawn track ends by the lake, which is likely the campsite; the pin itself is on no clearing.

273363.note: The pin sits by the sandy clearing at the lakeshore where the drawn spur ends.

273841.note: The pin sits on the building beside the pond, which is plainly the house, but the drawn road ends 30 m short of it; a short track along the pond's edge shows but isn't drawn.

10177496.note: Under full canopy: the pin sits in the forest between two drawn roads, 60 m from each, by a faint opening that may be the group site; no lane to it shows.

10294670.note: The pin sits on the open ground at the north edge of the campground, beside the drawn loop and the tracks that lead to it.

251161.note: The pin sits at the horse camp's loop with its trailers, corrals and building, and the drawn loop and road reach it.

233475.note: The pin sits on the open lawn with the shelter at the end of the drawn road on the point, which reaches its parking circle.

233557.note: The pin sits at the west edge of the group camp's parking lot, with tent pads along it in the trees, and the drawn lanes reach the lot.

233747.note: The pin sits by the group shelter and parking at the end of the drawn spur off the campground road.

233780.note: The pin is in forest between a road and a sewage lagoon; the listing's own point, 685 m north, is beside a row of paved RV pull-throughs, which look like ordinary campsites rather than a group area, so nothing is plainly the group site.

233914.note: The lidar intensity shows the drawn Shagbark Group Loop as a plain asphalt band with pull-offs, and the drawn road sits on it within about 3 m; the pin is inside the loop, 30 m from it. No pad or shelter shows at the pin under the canopy, and the listing's own point is 3.3 km away, but the loop's OpenStreetMap name agrees with the unit's point. Nothing traced.
